entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, whatever. Just get me a person. This is unbelievable.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return this piece of junk VeloBand you sold me. It's completely broken and I want my money back immediately. This is a scam!
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing an issue. I can definitely look into this for you. Could you please provide your order number?
It's VF-8675309. And you better be able to help, because I am not wasting my time with this.

Thank you. I have your order pulled up now. I see you purchased the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Are you kidding me? It's a technical fault! The thing is completely defective! The sensor is not working at all, it won't sync with the app, nothing! I've wasted hours on this garbage.

I understand your frustration completely. A device that won't sync is certainly not the experience we aim to provide. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you. Please hold for one moment.
Don't put me on hold! Just process the return. If you don't, I'll be speaking to your manager and leaving reviews on every single website you can imagine.

I understand, sir. No hold necessary, I'm just checking the information right now... Okay, thank you for your patience. I see here that your delivery was 34 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for a defective item.
Wait, really? So you're just going to give me the refund? No nonsense?
That's correct. Since the item is not working as expected, I have gone ahead and approved a full return. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file for you.
Huh. Okay. So I just print that and send the broken thing back?

Exactly. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be processed to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days.
Fine. Make sure that refund actually shows up.
I will personally ensure the return is processed correctly on our end. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
